title: c/4 diagonal ship
note: A c/4 diagonal spaceship, posted while the forum was trying to recover the Verizon site.

title: p10 c/5 ship (decade ship)
note: The first p10 object in the rule; named the decade ship on the wiki.

title: p4 moon gun (moon laser)
note: The first gun in Live Free or Die, a double-barreled p4 moon gun. Named the moon laser on the wiki.

title: Two growing spaceships
note: Spaceships that grow as they travel.

title: p12 anchor track flotillas
note: Two p12 ships built from anchor tracks; the second contains several p252 oscillators.

title: p8 c/2 ship
note: A new p8 c/2 spaceship that deletes its trails of dots like the dust mite ship.

title: c/2 p4 spaceship and backrake
note: Luke: “only the second known rake/puffer slower than c”, after Josh Ball’s c/5 backrake.

title: c p4 side rake
note: The smallest-period side rake, and the first sideways rake that isn’t a flotilla.

title: c p2 backrake
note: Luke: “the first known rake or puffer at p2.” Checked by simulation: the front end repeats every 2 generations.

title: c p6 side rake
note: A p6 side rake; the basic mechanism leaves debris, so a flotilla cleans it up.

title: New p4 oscillators and a big six shooter stack
note: Includes the oscillators catalogued as shortwave and longwave, and a new way to connect big six shooters.

title: Buffalo ships
note: A family of p4 c/2 ships with even bilateral symmetry, found with gfind and WLS. Catalogued as the buffalo ships.

title: Buffalo rake and ship
note: A p4 c/2 back rake; catalogued as the buffalo rake, then the smallest known c/2 puffer or rake.

title: Buffalo bird
note: A tagalong that can hop onto most known c/2 ships; it only needs two diagonally adjacent cells in its third generation.

title: p3 puffers (bent tricycle puffer)
note: A variation of the tricycle puffer and a single dot puffer.

title: Wave-riding ship
note: A p6 ship carrying an infinitely growing wave, found with WinLifeSearch using “don’t care” cells.

title: c/3 ship (wasp ship)
note: The first c/3 spaceship, which won one of Luke’s cash prizes. Named the wasp ship.

title: Extended wasp ships
note: The wasp ship is extensible.

title: c/2 backrake
note: A c/2 backrake.

title: c/2 backrake stabilized into a ship
note: The backrake with a component that eats the moons.

title: Sawtooth
note: A sawtooth: a c/2 ship adds a moon eater to a stream of moons, which a pair of monsters then destroys.

title: p5 oscillator (crossroads)
note: The second p5 oscillator after the starfish. Named crossroads.

title: Short free ship rake (freedom collider)
note: A p8 backward short free ship rake: apart from flotillas, the first rake that emits anything other than moons.

title: Anchored freedom collider
note: The freedom collider can be anchored.

title: Tiny c/2 ships (fruit fly ship)
note: The one on the left, with a minimum population of 36, tied the dust mite ship as the smallest c/2 ship. Named the fruit fly ship.

title: Small c/2 ships
note: Small c/2 ships.

title: p9 dot puffer
note: The first p9 object other than the arrow puffers.

title: p10 puffers
note: The first p10 puffers, and the only p10 craft that travel at c.

title: MMS breeder
note: The first breeder in Live Free or Die.

title: p5 c spaceship
note: A p5 c spaceship.

title: p2 rake (flicker rake)
note: A p2 rake, the second after Josh Ball’s July 2014 backrake (Luke hailed it as the first, but the earlier one is also p2). Probably the one catalogued as the flicker rake.

title: p2 wick puffer, stabilized
note: A p2 puffer whose wick is stabilized at the end.

title: p5 moon gun
note: A surprisingly small p5 moon gun, the second known working gun.

title: Bow tie
note: A p5 oscillator.

title: Short-necked giraffe
note: A smaller relative of the c/4 diagonal giraffe ship.

title: 5-dot seed for infinite growth
note: A five-dot seed for infinite growth.

title: Completed almost-rake
note: Luke’s old near-rake, completed four years later.

title: p9 puffer
note: A p9 puffer.

title: Small periodic MMS breeder
note: A much smaller periodic breeder, part of a large 2025 survey of rakes and breeders.

title: Tiny p12 and p24 free ship rakes
note: Very small free ship rakes, from the same series.

title: c/5 spaceship collection
note: Three p5 c/5 ships, at least two already known, in whose evolution all 102 isotropic neighborhood conditions occur.
